entries.rationale: For each named wFIAT asset, no documented recurring whole-supply liability-to-fiat-backing reconciliation cadence, common clock, process operator and complete scope was found. The whitepaper claims strict internal processes and optional attestations; March/June report endpoints are historical snapshots, not evidence of every intervening period or a defined recurring regime. June certificates for wBRL/wMXN/wCOP/wCLP were read individually; wCLP has contradictory currency/date text. Exchange custody PoR, bridge counters and ERC20 supply are not this datum. Explicit unknown scalars are preserved.

sources.assertion: USDC collateral identified; remote burn, attestations and release have no published finite realization horizon.

entries.rationale: Collateral is liquid USDC, but USDCx holders realize it through remote burn intents, independent attestations and release. Technical/API/code/legal/fee documents give the sequence, not a maximum end-to-end realization window. Underlying USDC immediacy cannot be copied onto the cross-chain escrow slice.
